name: reply-media
description: Draws the mermaid fences, math formulas and local images of a reply as pictures in the terminal, and plays its local videos (kitty graphics: Ghostty, kitty)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn this mod off without removing it. Takes effect at once.

resumedReplies.title: Replies redrawn on resume
resumedReplies.description: How many of a resumed session's last replies get their pictures drawn again. Each picture is rendered before the first prompt, so a higher number starts slower. 0 redraws none.

pxPerColumn.title: Picture pixels per column
pxPerColumn.description: How many pixels of a picture one terminal column shows. A lower number draws pictures larger.

cellAspect.title: Cell height over width
cellAspect.description: How many times taller than wide one terminal cell is. Change it when pictures look squashed or stretched. 2.17 was measured on Ghostty with JetBrains Mono 18.
